LanguageData.OverHaulers_Compatibility_Desc: Configure how caravan mass capacity is presented on pawn InfoCards when playing alongside other mods. Anatomical and biological calculations are always delivered universally to the game engine.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_PresentationMode_Auto_Toolti: Allows OverHaulers to adopt external caravan stats (such as VEF_MassCarryCapacity), injecting our detailed breakdown directly into their InfoCard. This prevents duplicate stat rows on pawns. If no external stats are detected, it cleanly falls back to the native OverHaulers card.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_PresentationMode_Native_Tool: Forces OverHaulers to always display its own dedicated 'Caravan mass capacity' card on pawns, leaving any third-party mod cards untouched. (Carrying capacity calculations remain fully active).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilScanIdleDesc: Dynamic bytecode inspection is idle. An active stat card is already configured. Scanning disassembles external Harmony patches on MassUtility.Capacity to discover candidate caravan stats from unlisted or new mods.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_NoCandidateStatsInPatch: - No caravan-related stats detected in this patch.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_NoExternalPatchesDiscovered: No external mod patches detected on MassUtility.Capacity.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Display: 1 single card: '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Gear: External gear (backpacks) and OverHaulers biological ratings are merged cleanly into this card.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on any colonist to view the combined OverHaulers anatomical breakdown.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Display: 1 native card: '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Gear: Standard vanilla gear calculations without external stat redirects.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on any colonist to view biological ratings, bionics, and injury breakdowns.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Display: May show 2 separate listings: '{0}' alongside the external mod's stat under pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Gear: Both stats remain visible on pawns. All caravan capacity and gear bonuses calculate safely without loss.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Confirm: If you prefer a single clean entry, select 'Automatic Selection' above or choose a matching profile below.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Display: Breakdown attached to '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Gear: Caravan InfoCard explanation is injected directly into this external stat.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on a colonist. If no OverHaulers breakdown appears or numbers do not update, select another candidate or revert to Automatic.
